definitions.explanation: Refers to each person separately within a group. Emphasizes individual responsibility or action.

examples.japanese: {各自|かくじ}⟦{持|も}ち{物|もの}→持ち物：03165_mochimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：00158_kakunin⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check your own belongings individually.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼食|ちゅうしょく}→昼食：01616_chuushoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{各自|かくじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：01746_youi⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧。
examples.english: Each person should prepare their own lunch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{各自|かくじ}⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Costs will be borne by each individual.

examples.japanese: {各自|かくじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}して→行動する：02728_koudou⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please act according to your own judgment.

examples.japanese: {各自|かくじ}⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
REGISTER: Formal. Often used in announcements, instructions, and official documents.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {各自|かくじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (by oneself, individually)
- {各自|かくじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (each person's)
- {各自|かくじ}⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧ (individual expense)
- {各自|かくじ}⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧ (individual judgment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{各々|おのおの}→各々：00334_onoono⟧ (each one - slightly more formal/literary)
- ⟦{銘々|めいめい}→銘々：03976_meimei⟧ (each person - casual to neutral)
- ⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧ (each, respectively - common, neutral)
- ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧ (individual - emphasizes the person)

NOTE: {各自|かくじ} emphasizes individual responsibility within a group context.
